earlier_sources: https://github.com/librefonts/jomolhari at 08671f0429160658734b73c0bf14bec35dd0fd84: TTX dumps of a build (24 files); no source.
disclose: The release kerns through a GPOS kern feature and also carries a legacy `kern` table (292 pairs). Shapers read the GPOS feature, which these sources keep; the legacy table, read only by software without GPOS support, is not carried.

The release carries a `PCLT` table (HP PCL 5 printer metrics; the OpenType specification says its use is strongly discouraged). fontc writes none, and no renderer reads it, so the build has no `PCLT`. Kept and disclosed.
gdef_classes_fea: the release's GDEF classes all 3333 glyphs base, 88 combining marks (U+0301 and on) included, and none mark; without it the build has no GDEF, HarfBuzz classes those marks itself, and 21955 shaped runs differ
